notes.title: Broken Saves Patch
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone, 

It's probably my 10th build today. Thanks to the help of a coder friend that plays the game, I may have been able to fix the broken saves. 
We ran this test on mutliple Steam accounts, with different saves, and it worked out every time. 

The patch is simple, open the broken saves, and you'll be met with a warning black screen and the message "Your save failed to load! Do you want to try and recover it?"

Just follow instructions, click once or twice, and create a new save. This new save will work and you will keep your progression. 

Thanks for your patience, 

MisterMaya[/p]

notes.title: Law School - Season 1 is coming on Steam!
notes.content:
[h2]Law School - Season 1 is officially complete![/h2]

See you all next month for the big release on [b]July 23rd 2025.[/b]

I’m incredibly excited to finally share this game with you after nearly two years of hard work and dedication.

As I write this update, Steam testers are reviewing the game. With five weeks left, I have just enough time to tackle the final tasks. My next priorities are:
[list]
[*][b]Adding the built-in official walkthrough directly in the game (no separate PDF needed)[/b]

[*][b]Implementing the Steam achievements for Season 1[/b]

[*][b]Completing the French translation[/b]
[/list]

[u]I’ll be working hard to make sure all of these are ready by launch day.[/u]

To stay up to date and not miss a thing, don’t forget to [b]wishlist[/b] the game — you’ll get notified about all release details.

Thank you all so much for your support. See you very soon!

MisterMaya

notes.title: Law School - Season 1 - Update #6
notes.content:
[h1]Hey everyone, and welcome to the final update for Law School – Season 1![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329292/6a47279e79106aea54a4584f5997ba8c5b3cbb0a.png[/img]

That’s right—the finish line is in sight!
Development is nearly complete, and I’ve just wrapped up the post-production phase of the final episode. Now, I’m preparing for the official launch on Steam.

[h2]Next up: Steam Next Fest begins next week![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329292/131045220540d1efaa90ac1f9548b5dfcda014fc.gif[/img]

This is your chance to dive deeper into Law School and get a taste of the full experience. The demo has been reworked with new features and updated renders—it’ll be going live again within the next few hours.

The full release is scheduled for July, but due to Steam's requirements, I won’t be announcing the exact date until the Fest wraps up. Expect a short update around June 17 to reveal the official launch day!

In the meantime, I’ll be updating the Store Page and working on a brand new, fully LEWD trailer—you won’t want to miss it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329292/7011866e12067d62db019e7287ce60693d370891.gif[/img]

Now let’s talk content. Here’s where things stand:

[h2]Season 1 Final Stats[/h2]
[b]📸 Images: 9,456
🎞️ Animations: 256
📜 Script: 137,760 words
🎮 Mini-Games: 7
🔥 Lewd Scenes: 17
🖼️ Unlockable Custom Images: 28
🎵 Soundtrack: 110 tracks
📱 Exclusive Facegram Posts: 74 (fully interactive)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329292/874dc2ccce061186a0d32712d62011257380157d.gif[/img]

I’m incredibly proud of how far the game has come. You’re looking at dozens of hours of gameplay, meaningful choices that shape your journey, and tons of secrets to uncover.

Both English and French will be available at launch, with Chinese, Turkish, and hopefully Russian coming shortly after. Other language options are still under consideration.

[h3]So… get ready. Wishlist the game, join us for Steam Fest, and I’ll see you in just over two weeks![/h3]

– MisterMaya

notes.title: Law School - Season 1 - Update #5
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone, and welcome to the fifth update for Law School - Season 1![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329292/cd256057b3b44523de5559b3704c739cced47c54.png[/img]

First of all, I’d like to remind you that we have a brand new trailer for Law School - Season 1. Hope you like it!

[previewyoutube=oRpxNmKiZGc;full][/previewyoutube]

This past month has exceeded my expectations. As of right now, I’m about 80 renders away (roughly two days of work) from completing the 3D portion of this season.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329292/ad66d900905e08fb688d0a04e892ab77cbb8be5e.gif[/img]

After that, I’ll go over all the renders and redo the ones that need fixing (this usually takes just a day).
That puts me nearly three weeks ahead of schedule. I worked like a maniac, but I didn’t expect it to pay off this well.

Now, what’s next:

There's a major post-work phase underway. I’m adding new phone functionalities, Facegram will take a bit of my time, I need to rework the intro, and there are a bunch of other elements to finalize.
I estimate I’ll be busy with this part until early June.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329292/d27e6433f4e515b460bbd0a49740454bc31f3e7b.gif[/img]

My goal is to send the game out for testing right after that—early June.

I can’t commit to a release date just yet, but I’ve got my sights set on July.
In the next update, once the post-work phase is nearly done, I’ll provide an exact release date.

Here are some stats for Season 1 of Law School:

Season 1 Current Progress:
📸 Images: 9,353
🎞️ Animations: 248
📜 Script: 136,582 words
🎮 Mini-Games: 7
🔥 Lewd Scenes: 16
🖼️ Unlockable Custom Images: 23
🎵 Soundtrack: 108 tracks

Note: The animation count will increase, as I haven’t received everything from my animator yet. Same goes for mini-games, custom images, and soundtrack elements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329292/de79f22d1b4b6546f63d1a78460d7755883309a8.gif[/img]

I’m pretty happy with these numbers, which should offer double-digit hours of gameplay.

That’s all for now! As usual, if you haven’t already wishlisted the game, please do so—it really helps.
Now, full speed ahead, and I’ll keep you updated in the next post.

See you soon,
MisterMaya

notes.title: Law School - Season 1 - Update #3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329292/dc79872de903b107ed78877473c33b6dfeb8c1e5.png[/img]
[h2]
Hello everyone, and welcome to the third update for Law School - Season 1![/h2]

Over the slightly shorter month of February, I’ve been working on DAY 4 of the third and final episode of Season 1. Progress has been solid, though slightly less than I anticipated—but for good reasons.
I ended up adding two extra scenes and reworking the final big scene of that day, which made the entire day a bit larger than originally planned. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329292/00ae0c7d7b582f66effbe5f284f2a7279e693253.gif[/img]

I’m now about 3–4 days away from completing DAY 4 and moving on to the next. In terms of overall progress, I’d say I’m about 50% done with this final episode—in just three months. That’s pretty exciting!

Next month, I’ll be tackling DAY 5 and hopefully DAY 6 as well. Big things are happening, so I’ve been spending extra time refining my renders to better match the mood of each scene. Seeing how everything is coming together makes me confident that you’re in for a treat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329292/bf3dbeb9942aaa29005a59d823aff0eeb5893d15.gif[/img]

[h2]Season 1 Current Progress: 
[/h2]
📸 Images: 7,126
🎞️ Animations: 220
📜 Script: 116,125 words
🎮 Mini-Games: 7
🔥 LEWD Scenes: 13
🖼️ Unlockable Custom Images: 23
🎵 Soundtrack: 108 tracks

We’re still on track for a Q3 2025 release, and I’m not worried. As long as I maintain this pace and don’t encounter too many hurdles (though they’re always inevitable), we should be able to stick to that timeline.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329292/6b6f806df47b43d443f49e6019e4cec6ac09b26c.gif[/img]

Also, Law School will be part of the Visual Novel Fest in March, starting in just two days! If you haven’t had a chance to check out the Demo, I highly recommend doing so—it won’t be available for a few months after the event.

That’s all for this update—thanks for reading, and I’ll see you next month!

MisterMaya

notes.title: Law School - Season 1 - Update #2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329292/2579b199c2f8b1f0b783c90103498de912f50c77.png[/img]

[h2]Hello everyone, and welcome to the second update for Law School - Season 1![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329292/cf22ba5a0a27dbda7e623699a389d18f5334846e.gif[/img]

Over the past month, I’ve been focusing on multiple aspects of development for the third and last episode of Season 1: writing, 3D work, post-processing, and coding. Before diving deeper into development, I took some time to refine my workflow and optimize production.

I built a third rendering station to increase my rendering power. I now have two computers working on rendering the images and the animations I create on my main workstation. 
Because I estimate this episode will be bigger than the first 2, I wanted to make sure I wouldn't be bottlenecked by my rendering power.

Since the last update, I’ve fully completed [b]Day 1[/b] in-game—meaning it’s now coded, playable, and integrated into the game files. Additionally, I’ve rendered all the images for [b]Day 2[/b] and am currently waiting for its animations to finish rendering. These first two days both contain LEWD scenes totaling 39 animations (*yikes*) , which made them quite large and time-consuming to produce.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329292/f05ea1164a695deb6718aed098bfadf09d399e2d.gif[/img]

I’m now actively working on [b]Day 3[/b], and I’ve already made solid progress.

[h3]Season 1 Current Progress:[/h3]

[b][list]
[*] Images: 6,378
[*] Animations: 189
[*] Script Lines: 15,132 lines of dialogue
[*] Mini Games: 6
[*] LEWD Scenes: 13
[*] Unlockable Custom Images: 23
[*] Soundtrack: 108 tracks
[/list]
[/b]
The numbers are looking strong! At this point, I estimate that I’m about [b]25-30% done[/b]with the third and final episode of Law School - Season 1, after roughly two months of development. As things stand, we’re still on track for a Q3 2025 release.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329292/8d30adfcf8a7e2c7cc80e8dffc28b3029239c34c.gif[/img]

By the time the next update rolls out, I expect to have [b]Day 3[/b] fully completed and to be in mid-development of [b]Day 4[/b]. Both [b]Day 4[/b] and [b]Day 5[/b] feature major scenes, so I anticipate spending extra time on them before moving on to smoother sections of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329292/e5876c8ffcc710149804ba2fb43013379289bced.gif[/img]

I hope you're happy with the progress so far! If you’d like to support the game, don’t forget to add it to your wishlist and spread the word to your friends.

That’s all for now—see you next month!

notes.title: Law School - Season 1 - Update #1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329292/503aec2b1c38ea68e54c54c18b348cb70ac525c2.png[/img]
[h1][b]
Hello everyone, and welcome to the first update of Law School - Season 1![/b][/h1]

Development of [b]Law School season 1[/b] has been underway for [b]16 months[/b]. With two episodes already released, I’m now focused on finishing the [b]final episode of the season[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329292/80d2d731c7db12a9d3a3fdb7777e6f53d08d37c4.gif[/img]

[u][h2]Here's a breakdown of where the game stands so far:[/h2][/u]

[list]
[*] Images: 6,052
[*] Animations: 164
[*] Script Lines: 14,041 lines of dialogue
[*] Mini Games: 6
[*] LEWD Scenes: 12
[*] Unlockable Custom Images: 23
[*] Soundtrack: 106 tracks
[/list]

These are strong figures, and we’re nearing about [b]2/3 of the total first season content[/b].

I have specific goals in mind for both the content and the release date (Q3 2025). The timeline is tight, but I work well under pressure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329292/1f3e437a9ed77d8851f8f070eec35640f8f213e0.gif[/img]

I know many of you are curious about which languages the game will support upon release. For sure, [i]Law School[/i] will be available in English and French, but I’m still in talks with translators for other languages. I’m hoping to add Russian, Spanish, and Portuguese, but I can’t promise they’ll be available at launch. I’m working with the translators from my first game, [i]The Entrepreneur[/i], on these languages.

In other news, I’m in the process of uploading the [b]demo [/b]of [i]Law School [/i]to Steam. Once it’s live, I’ll update you all. Plus, [i]Law School [/i]will be featured at the [b]Visual Novel Fest in March[/b], which is a big step in getting the game noticed.

The next 5-6 months will be critical as I work to finish Episode 3 and move into my review phase, where I’ll make sure everything functions correctly, achievements are in place, and so on. There’s still a lot to do, but I’m incredibly excited about what lies ahead.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329292/a2a8dfb88e7412b4990f0ae10dd37fdb4a9be95f.gif[/img]

I plan to post an update on the first of every month, so stay tuned! If you’d like to support the game, you can add it to your wishlist and spread the word to your friends.

That’s all for today. See you next month!

Best,
MisterMaya

notes.title: Law School made it to Steam!
notes.content:
[h1]Finally, Law School is Live on Steam! [/h1]

I’m thrilled to share this journey with you all as Law School comes to life! This post is a quick update on where the game stands and my plans for the months ahead as we gear up for the grand release of Law School - Chapter 1.

I began working on Law School in September 2023. Fast-forward 15 months, and today, the second episode of Law School - Chapter 1 has officially launched on my Patreon!

[h2]My Goal[/h2]
My focus is to complete an entire chapter before releasing it on Steam.

[h2]Progress So Far[/h2]
Here’s what we’ve accomplished together:

Story Images: 5,467
Animations: 140
Script Lines: 34,000
Facegram Roams: 7
Mini-games: 6
LEWD Scenes: 11
Custom Unlockable Renders: 23
Soundtrack: 104 Songs
It’s been an incredible journey, achieving all of this in just 15 months from scratch!

[h2]What’s Next?[/h2]
I estimate that Law School - Chapter 1 will be completed by July, which should realistically allow for a Steam release in Q3 2025.

A demo version of Law School featuring around 500 images + 9 animations will be released in February of next year during the Upcoming games SteamFest! I hope many of you will be excited to try it out.

I’ll keep you updated with monthly progress posts here on Steam, so you’re always in the loop about how things are coming along.

[h2]How You Can Help[/h2]
Want to support the game? Encourage your friends to wishlist it here on Steam—it makes a huge difference and helps me immensely.

Thank you for being part of this adventure. Wishing you all a fantastic week, and I’ll catch you next month with more updates!

- MisterMaya
